description: Runs mean-variance (Markowitz) optimization on a basket of symbols and returns optimized weights, allocations, and portfolio-level expected return, risk, and Sharpe ratio.

budget.description: Optional budget used to value shares and market values. Weights are budget-independent. Defaults to 10000.

cashUsage.description: Optional percent of available cash deployed into the optimized portfolio, from 0 to 100. Defaults to 0.

confidenceInterval.description: Optional value-at-risk confidence interval percent, from 1 to 99. Defaults to 95.

days.description: Optional trailing time window in days, from 30 to 720. Defaults to 90.

maxWeight.description: Optional maximum per-asset weight percent, from 0 to 100. Defaults to 35.

minWeight.description: Optional minimum per-asset weight percent, from 0 to 100. Defaults to 2.

minimumReturn.description: Optional minimum acceptable expected return as a decimal fraction, from -1 to 1 where 0.05 equals 5 percent. Defaults to 0.

risk.description: Optional target risk level from 0 (lowest risk) to 100 (highest risk). Defaults to 60.

riskFreeRate.description: Optional annual risk-free rate as a decimal fraction, from 0 to 1 where 0.01 equals 1 percent. Defaults to 0.01.

symbols.description: List of at least 2 and at most 25 ticker or Macroaxis symbol identifiers.

name: get_portfolio_optimization
